text:
maria_ops: Rolling NCCL 2.15.4 -> 2.16.0 canary to us-west-a100 pool now.
liam_runtime: heads up, last RC showed minor regressions on long-allgather paths.
devin_sre: saw 2 quick user-facing stalls in us-west-2 earlier, could be related.
carol_infra: which fleet? p4 vs a100?
maria_ops: only A100 NVLink pool so far (a100-nvlink-heavy). canary size = 10 nodes.
liam_runtime: monitoring p99 token latency + collectives count. enabling detailed nccl tracing for those 10 nodes.
deploy-bot: deploy started: canary/upgrade-nccl-2.16.0 -> nodes: a100-nvlink-heavy-0..9
maria_ops: after 3 minutes, one canary reported infinite recv timeout on allgather, job id 8421.
liam_runtime: paste logs:
```
[2024-04-02T16:23:45Z] NCCL WARN AllGather/AllReduce timeout on ring 2, timeout 30000ms
[2024-04-02T16:23:45Z] Process 0: peer 3 - p2p send stalled
[2024-04-02T16:23:45Z] nvlink error counters: link0=5 link1=0
```
devin_sre: interesting - nvlink counters bumped only on a single link. could be firmware+nccl interaction.
carol_infra: any driver/kernel change in this rollout? we only bumped nccl and kept CUDA/driver pinned.
liam_runtime: NVIDIA driver 535.86 pinned, CUDA 12.2 same as before. only NCCL moved.
maria_ops: severity: 2 incidents (short degraded tail latency). Canary still running but we should decide revert window.
devin_sre: request full perf traces (nvprof/insights) for the hung ranks and netstat from nodes.
liam_runtime: attaching quick trace summary from rank 0:
```
collective: allgather
sequence: send->wait->timeout
last successful step: step 42
kv cache size: 0
kernel: ncclCollectiveLL128
```
maria_ops: kv cache 0 is expected for these canaries (inference batch=1). strange that ll128 kernel used.
carol_infra: I can repro on a test bench with same driver+nccl, will run a stress with synthetic fanout.
maria_ops: cost impact if we roll forward and this hits prod? p99 spikes ~3x for 5-10% of batches during stall.
devin_sre: recommend: pause rollout, gather traces, expand canary with different topo (NVLink full/partial), run nvlink memtest.
liam_runtime: agree. also add a temporary policy to route heavy collective jobs to fallback model variant with smaller tensor sharding.
maria_ops: manual rollback scheduled in 30 minutes unless further evidence shows isolated hardware.
carol_infra: repro steps posted: small script below to trigger allgather-heavy workload on 4 GPUs
```
export NCCL_DEBUG=INFO
python3 tools/collective_stress.py --gpus 4 --iters 1000 --payload 128MB
```
liam_runtime: thanks, I'll run that on staging infra and compare kernel selection with old nccl.
devin_sre: if repro is consistent, plan: revert canary, file bug with NVIDIA with traces+nvlink counters, and coordinate fw check.
maria_ops: noted. I'll notify product ops and reduce canary to 2 nodes for now.
deploy-bot: scheduled rollback in 00:30:00 unless canceled.
carol_infra: one more datapoint: on a partial NVLink topology (DGX-like), the stalls show earlier at ~step 10.
liam_runtime: could be a ring algorithm regression that affects non-uniform link topologies.
devin_sre: action items:
- carol_infra: run stress + nvlink memtest and collect dmesg (due EOD)
- liam_runtime: run kernel selector diff between 2.15.4 and 2.16.0 on staging (2 hours)
- maria_ops: hold canary expansion and prepare rollback (15m)
- devin_sre: gather full NCCL trace archive and upload to support ticket (30m)
maria_ops: adding @oncall for notif. Thanks all, we should be conservative given inference latency sensitivity. :eyes:
liam_runtime: +1. I'll post results in this thread when staging runs finish.
carol_infra: kicked off stress now.
devin_sre: started trace collection.
maria_ops: will cancel expansion and watch.
liam_runtime: staging run shows same allgather kernel change and timeouts. leaning revert.
maria_ops: performing rollback now.
deploy-bot: rollback started: canary/upgrade-nccl-2.16.0 -> rollback to 2.15.4
maria_ops: rollback complete on canary nodes. tail latency returned to baseline.
liam_runtime: saving traces and creating ticket with NVIDIA SR-89241, attaching nvlink counters and kernel traces.
devin_sre: filing internal postmortem + recommendation: add topology diversity to canary profiles and nvlink memchecks pre-upgrade.
carol_infra: also recommend synthetic allgather stress in preflight job for future nccl bumps.
maria_ops: thanks team. follow-ups in #eng-infra backlog.
